name: Vedema Resort
insider_take: Perched on Santorini's dramatic Mesa Vouno ridge, Vedema Resort occupies a 400-year-old wine village where volcanic terroir meets Aegean luxury.
whats_special: This Luxury Collection gem sits in Megalochori, one of Santorini's most authentic villages, built directly into ancient wine cellars and traditional Cycladic houses. The property's unique architecture preserves original vaulted ceilings and stone walls, while the surrounding area is home to some of Greece's oldest wineries, including the famous Boutari Winery just minutes away.
pro_tip: Book the Wine Cave Suite to sleep in an actual 400-year-old wine cellar, and time your visit during harvest season (August-September) to witness traditional grape stomping at nearby Santo Wines.
dont_miss: The hidden chapel of Agia Irini (Saint Irene) - the ancient church that gave Santorini its name - sits just a 10-minute walk from the resort. Also explore the resort's private wine museum and sample rare Assyrtiko wines produced from vines grown in volcanic ash, some over 200 years old.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Aegean Sea views
Authentic Cycladic architecture blending luxury with local heritage
Exceptional fine dining with Mediterranean cuisine
cons: Remote location requires transportation to explore island
